shortDescription: A 30-day guided prayer journal for an anxious mind. One verse, a short reflection, two honest questions and room to pray, every day. Printable PDF in US Letter and A4.
description:
BE STILL is a 30-day guided prayer journal for the mind that will not slow down.

It will not tell you to stop worrying, and it will not say that worry means weak faith. It gives you ten calm minutes a day to bring what is in your head to God, honestly.

EACH DAY HAS ONE PAGE
- A Bible verse, printed in full
- A short reflection (about a minute to read)
- Two honest questions with room to write
- A prayer starter you finish in your own words

THE FOUR WEEKS
1. Named: saying what is really going on
2. Near: who is with you when the fear comes
3. Now: coming back to today
4. Steady: what holds when you feel shaky

WHAT YOU GET
- {{PAGES}} pages: 30 daily pages, 4 weekly pause pages, a beginning and a closing page, and a 2-page prayer list
- 2 PDF files: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4
- Clean pages that are easy on printer ink

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped. After you pay, download the PDFs and print at home or at a print shop. You can also write on the pages in a tablet notes app such as GoodNotes or Notability.

GOOD TO KNOW
- This journal is a companion for prayer and reflection. It is not medical care or counseling, and it does not treat anxiety disorders. If anxiety is affecting your sleep, eating or work, please talk to a doctor or a licensed counselor.
- Scripture is quoted from the World English Bible (WEB), a public-domain modern English translation. Where the WEB uses the name Yahweh, many translations print "the LORD".
- Written from a Christian point of view, with no particular denomination assumed.
- For personal use. If you lead a small group, class or care ministry, the group license listing covers printing for up to 25 people.

Because this is a digital file, returns are not possible, but if anything is wrong with your download, message us and we will make it right.
disclosure: How this was made: this journal was planned, written and laid out with the help of AI tools, then read, edited and approved page by page by a person. Scripture is quoted directly from the World English Bible and was not generated.
